title: Course Page 2026

fields.label: Use the 2026 course design
fields.name: c26_enabled
fields.instructions: Turn on to render this course with the 2026 template. Turn off to fall back to the existing layout. Product, FAQs and SEO fields elsewhere on this screen are shared.

fields.label: Breadcrumb parent
fields.name: c26_breadcrumb_parent
fields.instructions: Shown as Home / TEFL Courses / [this] / Course title. Leave empty to skip.

fields.label: Heading
fields.name: c26_hero_title
fields.instructions: Leave empty to use the course title.

fields.label: Hero image
fields.name: c26_hero_image
fields.instructions: Landscape or square, at least 1200px wide.

fields.label: Promo cards
fields.name: c26_promos
fields.instructions: E.g. English level test and Salary calculator.

fields.label: Line under each module
fields.name: c26_modules_footnote
fields.default_value: Ends in a quiz you can retake

fields.label: Certificate image
fields.name: c26_cert_image
fields.instructions: Optional. If empty, a styled sample certificate is drawn using the title below.

fields.label: Card heading
fields.name: c26_cert_card_heading
fields.default_value: See the certificate you will receive

fields.label: Card text
fields.name: c26_cert_card_text
fields.default_value: Every certificate has a unique number employers can check online.

fields.name: c26_faq_message
fields.message: Questions come from the existing Frequently Asked Questions fields further down this screen (with GB / ZA / NL / CA / FR versions). Edit them there.

fields.label: Intro
fields.name: c26_faq_intro
fields.default_value: The questions students and parents ask us most.

fields.name: c26_price_message
fields.message: The price comes from the Course Product field (WooCommerce), including country pricing and sale prices. Change the price on the product, not here.

fields.label: Add-on products
fields.name: c26_addons
fields.instructions: Real WooCommerce products. Name and price are pulled from each product.

fields.label: Small print under button
fields.name: c26_price_note
fields.default_value: Buy now, pay later available · 14-day money back guarantee

fields.label: Offer ends
fields.name: c26_countdown_end
fields.instructions: Countdown hides itself automatically after this time (site timezone).

fields.label: Small label
fields.name: c26_cta_kicker
fields.instructions: Leave empty to use the course title.

description: Fields for the 2026 course page template (course-page-2026.php).
